To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The majority of transformants obtained with linearized monomeric plasmid DNA arise following intramolecular recombinations that generate a recircularized molecule.2) The proportion of transformants that contain deleted molecules is dependent on the rec status of host and the ligation state of the plasmid.3) The proportion of linear oligomers present in a preparation of linearized monomermic plasmid DNA is variable and depends on the method used to prepare linear DNA.
the transformation of Eschericia coli by linearized pBR 322 DNA is reduced 100 fold relative to that of circular DNA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms of DNA transformation in Escherichia Coli.
the molecular basis of transformation in E. coli.
understanding the molecular mechanisms that underlie transformation with linear plasmid DNA and the role of DNA recombination during transformation with circular plasmid DNA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mechanism for transformation of linear plasmid DNA is by recombination.
linear monomer plasmid DNA is transformed with a low efficiency, but linear dimers are transformed with a high efficiency.
the mechanism of transformation by linearized plasmids is recombination-dependent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
recombination-dependent recircularisation is a significant process for linearized plasmids.

the transformation of Eschericia coli by linearized plasmids is not due to the direct intracellular reannealment and ligation of two SalI ends, but by recombination-dependent recircularisation of the linear plasmid.
the mechanism of plasmid transformation in E.coli is not simple, but is a complex and intricate process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
linear plasmid DNA can transform bacteria at frequencies comparable to those obtained with circular DNA, but that deletions can be observed in the transformants if the linear DNA has cohesive ends.
the transformation efficiency of plasmids with cohesive termini is reduced in the absence of RecA and RecBCD, and that the transformation efficiency increases in the presence of DNA ligase.
linear plasmids can transform with high frequency, and that the transformation frequency of linearized plasmds is not affected by the presence or absence of the recA gene.
